items.title: Sam Altman warns against a future where AI, not humans, calls the shots
items.summary: Altman and Greg Brockman pushed back against Silicon Valley's growing debate over an AI takeover, while acknowledging the challenges of keeping advanced models under human control.
items.creator: Sarah Perez

items.title: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman says it’s ‘hard to imagine the AI industry without Jensen’
items.summary: Nvidia founder and former CEO Jensen Huang stepped down last week amid several scandals, including an affair with an alleged Chinese spy.
items.creator: Amanda Silberling
